contract: Dependency description of the current agent. Commands are documented, not executed by this manifest. No dedicated third_party installer/checker is provided. Configuration/file presence is not inference or scientific validation.
license_note: Scientific model license labels reproduce the agent registry. Check the deployed code, weights, data and service terms separately; no new upstream license audit is asserted.

symbolic_paths.{data}: ANTIBODY_DATA_DIR; run.sh defaults to {agent}/.antibody-agent. Direct wheel use falls back to XDG/user cache when no source checkout exists.
symbolic_paths.{model.field}: The corresponding model entry field in runtimes.json; a native model python field defaults to the current interpreter.
symbolic_paths.{model.python_dir}: Directory containing the selected scientific Python executable
symbolic_paths.{model.command[0]}: Executable at argv element zero in the configured JSON bridge command

runtime_contract.bridge_command: An operator-configured argv array. The gateway appends request.json and result.json paths. No shell expansion.
runtime_contract.environment: Each scientific interpreter must import agent base dependencies and its own backend packages. Absolute asset paths are recommended. The gateway sets offline/cache variables; custom bridges remain trusted operator code.
runtime_contract.availability: doctor reports configured_unverified/unavailable, or planner config presence; it does not load models, inspect all weight shards, or certify scientific readiness.

delivery_requirements: Complete paired VH/VL or explicit VHH with valid numbering and edit constraints; native automatic numbering uses ANARCII/IMGT.
Only the selected generation routes require their generators; library analysis does not require a generation model.
Independent ImmuneBuilder fold and corresponding TAP (VH/VL) or TNP (VHH) profiling evidence.
Independent positive-state complex/epitope evaluation; BoltzGen-origin candidates use Chai-1 instead of Boltz-2.
Required native-context checks, frozen policy and identity/provenance validation before human delivery. Missing mandatory resources withhold candidates.

Complete paired VH/VL or explicit VHH and pairing provenance
